answer_text:
There isn’t one single “best” site for everyone—what’s best depends on whether you prioritize price, quality, selection, shipping, or support. Here are the most reliable options by use case:

## Best overall (broad selection + good fulfillment)
- **Rogue Fitness (roguefitness.com)** – Excellent quality (especially racks, barbells, plates), strong customer support, lots of parts/attachments. Often a top pick if you want gear that lasts.
- **REP Fitness (repfitness.com)** – Great value-to-quality for racks, benches, storage, and attachments; often cheaper than Rogue for comparable home-gym setups.

## Best for budget / fast shipping
- **Amazon (amazon.com)** – Fast delivery and easy returns; quality varies a lot by brand, so stick to well-reviewed, known brands.
- **Walmart (walmart.com)** – Competitive pricing; good for basics (dumbbells, bands, benches), but verify seller and return policy.

## Best for cardio machines
- **Dick’s Sporting Goods (dickssportinggoods.com)** – Solid selection and delivery/assembly options depending on location.
- **Costco (costco.com)** – Good deals and customer-friendly returns; selection changes frequently.

## Best for premium / specialty pieces
- **Eleiko (eleiko.com)** – High-end barbells/plates; excellent but expensive.
- **Sorinex (sorinex.com)** – Premium racks and custom/sport-performance setups.

## Best used (big savings)
- **Facebook Marketplace** – Often the best prices locally; inspect before buying.
- **Craigslist / OfferUp** – Good deals; varies by area.
- **Play It Again Sports (playitagainsports.com)** – Used equipment with some level of store screening.

### If you tell me:
1) your budget, 2) what you want (rack/barbell/dumbbells/cardio), and 3) your country/region,  
I can recommend the best 2–3 sites and specific brands/models to target.
query_text: What is the best website to buy home gym equipment?
